تجتنوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَنُوا (tajtanū) /tad͡ʒ.ta.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
# تُجْتَنَوْا (tujtanaw) /tud͡ʒ.ta.naw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَنَى (ijtanā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
